content_sections.heading: About KMCLU Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University is a university in Lucknow, located at Sitapur-Hardoi Bypass Road, Lucknow–226013. The Project Assistant will work on a Research & Development project led by Dr. Sweta Agarwal that studies the status of higher education in non-government degree colleges of Barabanki District, Uttar Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Post Graduate Degree in a relevant discipline from a recognized University. Desirable: Knowledge of research methodology, field survey, data collection and MS Office. The notice does not mention any age limit or required experience for the post. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration for the Project Assistant is "as per applicable R&D Scheme/University norms". The notice does not print a monthly amount, and it does not mention HRA or other allowances. The engagement lasts 8 months, from 01 December 2026 to 31 July 2027. The notice describes the nature of engagement as purely temporary/project-based.

content_sections.heading: KMCLU Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these job responsibilities: Field survey Data collection Data entry Tabulation and compilation Preliminary data analysis Literature collection Assistance in preparation of the project report

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KMCLU Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Interested candidates may submit their CV/Bio-data to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Sweta Agarwal, Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University, Lucknow, by 26 November 2026. The notice does not mention whether the application should be sent by post, by email or handed in, and it prints no separate application form. Documents named in the notice: CV/Bio-data Copies of educational qualifications Relevant documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be made by the duly constituted Selection Committee/competent authority as per applicable University rules. The notice does not mention an interview date, a test or the mode of selection.
